acceptanceCriteria.note: Reuses the RC-02 shadow boundary and the existing digest-only shadow_wire receipt; no new store/registry/router.
resolveEnvelopeRejectEnabled defaults false; explicit false and unset env keep the observational path byte-identical.
Invalid envelope refused before fetchWithSsrFGuard; measured provider fetch calls = 0 and a typed ProviderEnvelopeRejectedError is raised.
The pre-existing digest-only wire receipt is written before the refusal; no raw prompt/body/headers are persisted.
SSRF, timeout, proxy, redirect and outbound-budget rules are untouched.
S01 tests 3/3, guard regression 15/15, tsgo:core 0, scoped lint 0, harness validate/dry-run pass, comms replay/compare 0, credential scan 0 hits, SHA256SUMS verifiable.
No product default/lock/approval change; README reviewed (no user-visible change); not real-human evidence.
